addictionPotential: 高度生理成瘾，心理成瘾中等至高度。
summary: 一种 GHB 前药，吸收快，起效更快且持续更短。用法类似 GHB，作为较低毒性的酒精替代品。应慢慢服用而非“吞一口”，可显著提高安全性并降低过量风险。
effectsSummary: GBL is a prodrug of GHB with similar effects: euphoria, disinhibition, increased libido, sedation. Faster onset and more potent than GHB.
dosageRemark: GBL is approximately twice as potent as GHB. The difference between a recreational dose and overdose is very small.
generalRisks: Very narrow safety margin. Overdose causes vomiting, unconsciousness, respiratory depression, death. Mixing with alcohol is extremely dangerous.
longtermRisks: Dependence develops quickly. Withdrawal can be severe and life-threatening, requiring medical detox.
saferUse: 用注射器精确测量剂量。
切勿与酒精或其他抑制剂同用。
第一次剂量后至少 3-4 小时内不要重复使用。
[TBT] People with epilepsy, heart or kidney dysfunction should not consume GBL under any circumstances!
[TBT] GBL withdrawal should only be carried out under medical supervision.
[TBT] Never leave your drink unattended to avoid someone mixing GBL into your drink. If your drink tastes strange, pour it out for your own safety.

tolerance.full: [TBT] within several days of continuous use
